meta.title: Athens, Crete & Paris Summer 2027
meta.dates: July 17 - August 1, 2027 (Miami -> Athens -> Crete -> Paris -> Miami)

blocks.title: Arrive MIA, check bags
blocks.detail: Arrive 3+ hrs before an international itinerary with a family of 4.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA2764 - MIA -> PHL - Nonstop - 2h58m
blocks.detail: MIA -> PHL, Economy, 4 passengers, Boeing 737-800.
blocks.notes: Part of a single connecting itinerary booked via Alaska Atmos Rewards (partner award on American, oneworld).

blocks.title: Layover at PHL
blocks.detail: 5h22m layover - long but real, built into the fare as shown.
blocks.notes: Lunch/dinner in the terminal, budget ~$60 for the family.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA758 - PHL -> ATH - Nonstop - 9h20m
blocks.detail: PHL -> ATH, Economy, 4 passengers, Boeing 787-9. Overnight flight, lands 9:10 AM local time Sunday, July 18 Athens time.
blocks.notes: 35,000 Atmos Rewards points + $25.60/passenger x 4 = 140,000 points + $102.40 total, per the fare shown when searched (confirmed real fare, per screenshot). Total itinerary: 17h40m including the PHL layover.

blocks.title: Land at ATH - immigration, bags, customs
Taxi to hotel
blocks.detail: Flat-rate airport taxi to central Athens - €40 (5am-midnight), set by Athens Municipality regardless of traffic/route.
blocks.notes: €40 flat rate (~$44); if a driver claims no flat rate applies, that's a red flag - take a different taxi.

blocks.title: Grand Hyatt Athens - check in
blocks.detail: Grand Suite (Acropolis views), via a complimentary Suite Night Award (World of Hyatt Globalist benefit, space-available upgrade - no extra points cost for the upgrade itself, not guaranteed until confirmed).
blocks.notes: 20,000 points/night x 3 nights = 60,000 points for the base room rate, upgraded to the Grand Suite via a Suite Night Award. Daily breakfast included for up to 4 guests (Globalist benefit) - no separate breakfast cost budgeted below.
blocks.roomType: Grand Suite (Acropolis views) via Suite Night Award upgrade
blocks.flag: Suite Night Award upgrades are space-available, not guaranteed - confirm status before finalizing plans that assume the suite specifically. Hotel is ~25 min walk to the Acropolis/Plaka (not walkable-close like some central options) - budget taxi/tram time for daily trips into the old town.

blocks.title: Rest at the hotel
blocks.detail: Deliberately no anchor activity today given the overnight flight - jet lag buffer.

blocks.title: Dinner - Ergon House Athens
blocks.detail: Greek deli/food-hall format near Syntagma/Plaka - olive tree display, deli counters, browsing format that's easy and low-key for a jet-lagged first night.

blocks.title: Breakfast at hotel - early start
blocks.detail: Included daily via Globalist benefit.

blocks.title: The Acropolis
blocks.detail: Earliest bookable slot (8-9am) to beat July heat and crowds - the 8-9am and 9-10am slots fill weeks ahead in summer. Realistic 60-90 min on-site with kids before heat becomes an issue.
blocks.notes: €30/adult, kids under 5 free (still need a zero-value timed ticket). Timed entry mandatory via the official hhticket.gr platform - budgeting ~€120/$130 for the family including some buffer.
blocks.flag: Book on hhticket.gr as soon as the booking window opens - capacity caps at ~20,000/day and early slots sell out weeks ahead in July. Deliberately skipping the Acropolis Museum, consistent with this family's no-museums preference.

blocks.title: Plaka old town wander
blocks.detail: Narrow lanes, small shops, Anafiotika's whitewashed island-style quarter.

blocks.title: Lunch - To Kafeneio
blocks.detail: Traditional taverna/mezedes at the foot of the Acropolis, Plaka.

blocks.title: Rest at the hotel
blocks.detail: Real buffer after a big morning on foot in July heat.

blocks.title: Dinner - Kuzina
blocks.detail: Modern Greek, Adrianou St., Plaka, views of the Temple of Hephaestus.

blocks.title: National Garden
blocks.detail: Free, shaded park next to Syntagma/Parliament - a real green-space morning rather than more pavement.

blocks.title: Taxi to the Lycabettus funicular base
Lycabettus Hill funicular
blocks.detail: Runs every 10-30 min. Ride itself is in a tunnel - the view is at the top.

blocks.title: Lycabettus summit - panoramic sunset views
blocks.detail: Best views of Athens and the Acropolis from above, timed for early evening to avoid midday heat.

blocks.title: Dinner - Lithos Taverna
blocks.detail: Greek mezze, live folk music, courtyard seating - festive last-Athens-night dinner.

blocks.title: Aegean Airlines - ATH -> HER - Nonstop - 55m
blocks.detail: Athens -> Heraklion, Economy, 4 passengers. Aegean/Sky Express run ~13 flights/day combined on this route.
blocks.notes: ~€55/person one-way x4 -> ~€220/$232. Indicative aggregator pricing, not a locked fare - confirm exact 2027 schedule closer to booking.

blocks.title: Pick up rental car - Heraklion Airport
blocks.detail: Needed for the whole Crete stay - Spinalonga's departure point, Agios Nikolaos, and day trips are all a drive from Elounda.
blocks.notes: Estimate: ~$85/day (peak July SUV pricing) x 7 days = ~$595. Book well ahead for July availability and child seats.

blocks.title: Drive to Elounda
blocks.detail: ~40-45 miles via the Hersonissos corridor, ~45min-1h10m depending on traffic.

blocks.title: Domes of Elounda, Autograph Collection - check in
blocks.detail: Family Suite - 1 King bed + sofa bed, garden view, balcony, outdoor whirlpool, ~968 sq ft, separate bedroom/living room.
blocks.notes: 613,500 Marriott Bonvoy points total for 7 nights (~87,600/night average). Built like a traditional Cretan village around an agora; free kids club ages 4-12 (both kids qualify).
blocks.roomType: Family Suite (1 King + sofa bed, garden view, balcony, whirlpool)

blocks.title: Settle in / resort beach & pool
blocks.detail: Light first afternoon.

blocks.title: Dinner - Thólos (resort)
blocks.detail: On-site Greek/Mediterranean, theme dinner nights - easy first night, zero transit.

blocks.title: Drive to Plaka village boat dock
blocks.detail: ~5km from Elounda.

blocks.title: Boat to Spinalonga
blocks.detail: First boat of the day, deliberately - the island gets crowded 11:30am-2:30pm with almost no shade, and bare stone can exceed 35°C in July.

blocks.title: Spinalonga Island
blocks.detail: The Venetian fortress and former leper colony - walkable ruins and streets, not an indoor museum.
blocks.notes: €20/adult entrance, kids likely free/reduced (verify at booking) -> budgeting ~€90-100/$100 for the family total (boat + entry).

blocks.title: Lunch - Taverna Spinalonga, Plaka village
blocks.detail: Seaside, fresh fish, right by the boat dock.

blocks.title: Dinner - Vilebrequin La Plage (resort)
blocks.detail: Seaside Mediterranean/seafood, on-site.

blocks.title: Resort beach & pool - free morning
blocks.detail: No anchor today - kids club available (free, ages 4-12) if the kids want a program morning.

blocks.title: Lunch - Antonino's (resort)
blocks.detail: On-site Italian, wood-fired pizza/pasta.

blocks.title: Dinner - Ostria, Elounda
blocks.detail: Seafood, 1.4km from the resort.

blocks.title: Agios Nikolaos - Lake Voulismeni & harbor
blocks.detail: Small saltwater lake connected to the harbor by a canal, lively waterfront promenade.

blocks.title: Lunch - Karnagio (Pita tou Riga)
blocks.detail: Right on Lake Voulismeni, grill-focused - arrive early, it's busy.

blocks.title: Dinner - Kanali, Elounda
blocks.detail: Seafood, 3.5km from the resort.

blocks.title: Boat trip & snorkeling, Mirabello Bay
blocks.detail: Elounda Boat Rentals & Watersports - family-run since 1984, no-license boat rentals, kayaking/SUP/snorkeling in the bay's sea caves.
blocks.notes: Half-day no-license boat rental estimate ~€150-180/$160-190 for the family - get a live quote closer to booking.

blocks.title: Dinner - Blue Door (Mple Porta), Agios Nikolaos
blocks.detail: Waterfront seafood, grilled octopus.

blocks.title: Drive to Milatos Cave
blocks.detail: ~45 min.

blocks.title: Walk to the cave entrance
blocks.detail: ~10-15 min walk, closed shoes needed.

blocks.title: Milatos Cave
blocks.detail: Free entry, family-friendly, low ceilings inside (bring a phone flashlight) - real historical site (1823 massacre memorial), not a museum.

blocks.title: Drive to the Lassithi Plateau
blocks.detail: ~45min-1hr from the Milatos/Agios Nikolaos area via Zenia/Mesa Potami.

blocks.title: Lassithi Plateau - windmills & village
blocks.detail: Famous (mostly decommissioned) stone windmills across the high plateau - a scenic single stop, kept modest rather than a full day given the drive.

blocks.title: Dinner - Makris Fine Dining (resort)
blocks.detail: Michelin-affiliated chef Petros Dimas, FNL Best Restaurant Award 2022 - the special night of the Crete stay.

days.title: Beach day / resort - last day in Crete

blocks.title: Lunch - Taverna Maria's, Plaka village
blocks.detail: Traditional Cretan dishes, one more trip to the pretty little harbor before leaving.

blocks.title: Dinner - Taverna Giorgos-Giovanni, Plaka village
blocks.detail: On the rocks overlooking Spinalonga - a fitting send-off view for the last Crete night.

blocks.title: Drive to Heraklion Airport, return rental car
Air France (rep.) - HER -> Paris (CDG) - Direct - 3h30m
blocks.detail: Heraklion -> Paris CDG, Economy, 4 passengers. Air France runs this route seasonally (roughly April-October) - confirm it's operating for summer 2027.
blocks.notes: Aggregator 'from' fares as low as $67-129/person one-way looked like teaser basic-economy pricing - budgeting a more realistic ~$130/person x4 = ~$520. Confirm against actual 2027 dates once schedules publish.
blocks.flag: Not yet bookable - placeholder flight/time. Seasonal route - reconfirm it's operating before counting on it.

blocks.title: Transfer to hotel
blocks.detail: CDG -> 14th arrondissement, ~45min-1hr by taxi/RER depending on traffic.

blocks.title: Paris Marriott Rive Gauche - check in
blocks.detail: Family Suite (1BR, premium bedding, minibar).
blocks.notes: Estimated at $400/night x 4 nights = $1,600 - same estimate basis used on the Rome/Sardinia/Paris comparison trip. Treat as a placeholder pending a live July 2027 quote.
blocks.flag: Price is an estimate, not a quote.

blocks.title: Dinner - Brasserie, Paris Marriott Rive Gauche
blocks.detail: On-site brasserie - easy first night after a full travel day.

blocks.title: Metro Line 6 - Saint-Jacques to Bir-Hakeim
blocks.detail: Direct, no transfer, ~12 min.

blocks.title: Eiffel Tower - 2nd floor by elevator
blocks.detail: 2nd floor rather than summit - full views, shorter lines, no wind exposure, better for kids 6-9.
blocks.notes: ~€60/$65 for the family (2026 pricing basis). E-tickets open exactly 60 days ahead at ticket.toureiffel.paris.
blocks.flag: Book at the 60-day mark - July sells out same-day.

blocks.title: Walk to Port de la Bourdonnais
Seine River Cruise - Bateaux Parisiens
blocks.detail: Departs at the foot of the tower, ~1hr, individual audio guide.

blocks.title: Lunch - Le Casse-Noix
blocks.detail: Near the Tower, French bistro. Open Mon-Fri only (Thursday works).

blocks.title: Dinner - I Grappoli
blocks.detail: ~7 min walk from hotel. Italian trattoria, real menu variety.

blocks.title: Metro Line 4 - Denfert-Rochereau to Château Rouge
blocks.detail: ~23 min, no transfer.

blocks.title: Sacré-Cœur exterior & parvis
blocks.detail: Exterior only, arriving before the 11am crowd build.

blocks.title: Lunch - Chez Plumeau
blocks.detail: Steps from Place du Tertre. No reservations - arrive close to opening.

blocks.title: Dinner - Le Relais Gascon
blocks.detail: Montmartre. Southwest French classics, family-friendly.

blocks.title: Walk to Luxembourg Gardens
blocks.detail: ~20 min from the hotel.

blocks.title: Luxembourg Gardens
blocks.detail: Pond with rentable toy sailboats, main gardens wander.

blocks.title: Latin Quarter wander
blocks.detail: Rue Mouffetard, Panthéon exterior, Sorbonne area.

blocks.title: Lunch - Le Choupinet
blocks.detail: Directly across from the gardens, brasserie with real menu variety.

blocks.title: Rest at the hotel, pack
blocks.detail: Last full day.

blocks.title: Dinner - Brasserie, Paris Marriott Rive Gauche
blocks.detail: On-site again deliberately for the last night, easy given tomorrow's early flight.

blocks.title: Paris Marriott Rive Gauche - check out (next morning)
blocks.detail: Checkout is actually the morning of Aug 1 - reminder for packing/logistics on the last evening.

blocks.title: Paris Marriott Rive Gauche - check out
Delta / Air France - CDG -> MIA - Nonstop - ~9h45m
blocks.detail: Paris -> Miami, Economy, 4 passengers. Arrives Miami same day given the westbound time change.
blocks.notes: Estimated at ~37,500 SkyMiles/passenger x4 = ~150,000 points, within Delta's typical dynamic transatlantic economy range - not live-quoted for this route/date, confirm at booking. French bee (budget, ~9hrs, 3x/week from Orly) is a cash-fare alternative if points space isn't available.
